messages:
Iris Park: Quick microcopy nit on the 'Set default model' CTA. Right now the button says 'Set as default' and users aren't sure whether it affects existing endpoints.
Drew Malone: Heard that in research. People worry it will change live routes. We should be explicit.
Samir Patel: Implementation detail: it only updates the user's account default for new routes; it doesn't mutate existing deployments. We can show that as a short subtext.
Iris Park: Proposed primary CTA: 'Set as default for new routes' Subtext: 'This won't change existing endpoints or rolling deployments.'
Drew Malone: Love the clarity. Accessibility point: subtext should be linked to a 'Learn more' modal with aria-label 'What default model changes affect' not just 'Learn more'.
design-bot: Accessibility lint: avoid generic link text 'Learn more' alone. Provide descriptive link text and ensure subtext is in DOM.
Samir Patel: Also add a small telemetry event 'model.default.changed' and include model_name and scope='new_routes' so product can track.
Iris Park: Localization keys: 'buttons.model.set_default_new_routes', 'buttons.model.set_default_note'. Final copy for translations: Button: 'Set as default for new routes' Note: 'This won't change existing endpoints or rolling deployments.'
Drew Malone: LGTM from UX. I'll add the note under the button in lighter weight and wire the aria-describedby to the button.
Iris Park: Thanks :+1:
